messages.subject: August/September time recording - outstanding entries
messages.plaintextBody:
Colleagues,

Our records show outstanding time entries for August and September. Please ensure all narratives are posted by Friday 10 October so we can run the month-end WIP report. Partners, kindly review and release draft bills on your matters.

Regards,
Accounts | Whitfield Carter LLP
